clips.title: The story
paras: At the heart of the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Kaltunk welcomes young orcs and points them toward their first duties for the Horde.

Kaltunk watches over new arrivals in the Valley of Trials and directs them toward Gornek and the path of discipline. While trainers and elders set trials and hunting rites, the orc overseer gives recruits clear orders so they know where to go.

The Valley of Trials was chosen to test the strength and resilience of the youths who walk its canyon floors. Kaltunk brings the same rugged practicality to his work. He offers no grand speeches or coddling, and expects each orc to find a place in the world and serve the warchief.
